tab.progress.blurb: FR-3.1 — rolling DPS and clear time per hunt, filterable by monster, quest, stars, weapon, hunter.
tab.growth.blurb: Instance-weighted DPS change with per-group trends (median, best, slope, clear time). Single hunter drill-down, multi-hunter scope, monster/star/weapon/variant filters.
tab.weapons.blurb: FR-3.2 — avg/peak DPS, hunt count and clear rate by weapon type.
tab.highlights.blurb: Quest-end hunter highlights (awards) and average damage share, per monster/weapon/hunter. REFramework hunts only.
tab.curves.blurb: FR-3.3 — per-hunt cumulative damage overlay for all party members, monster HP curve, enrage markers.
tab.hunts.blurb: Every run, latest first — click a row for party damage, DPS, hunter highlights and the damage curve.
tab.survival.blurb: Per-hunter HP and DPS over time with time-in-danger summary. Requires HuntDumper 0.11+.
tab.leaderboard.blurb: Best players by DPS over cleared hunts — filterable by monster, stars, weapon and min hunts.
tab.highscores.blurb: One row per cleared hunt, ranked by top DPS or fastest clear. Scoped to the hunters bar above; filterable by monster, weapon and stars.
tab.compare.blurb: Your scoped hunters vs the whole party, hunt by hunt. Star yourself in the hunters bar above.
tab.activity.blurb: Hunt volume, clear rate and damage output day by day.
tab.synergy.blurb: FR-3.4 — clear time and damage share by teammate pairing (supporters excluded).
tab.buffs.blurb: Consumable, skill, song and debuff uptime for the local player, plus the monster's enrage and ailment timeline. Recorded by the HunterPie Analytics companion.
